tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.1: Place it on the ground, then fuel it with coal, charcoal or blaze rods.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.2: WASD steers, jump climbs, sprint descends.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.3: Sneak and use it empty-handed to open the cargo hold.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.4: Use dye on it to color the balloon.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship_cannon.1: Use on your airship to mount it at the bow.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship_cannon.2: At the helm, press V to fire. Each shot burns some fuel.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship_cannon.3: Planks patch a hull holed by cannon fire.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dewdrop.1: Only tiny eyes can find these in the grass.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dewdrop.2: Pixel Miners pay well for them.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_armor.1: Use on your tamed dragon to armor it.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_egg.1: Set it down and wait: it hatches into a dragon
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_egg.2: that bonds with whoever is closest.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_heart.1: Give it to your grown dragon to make it an Elder:
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_heart.2: bigger, tougher, with stronger breath and a faster power.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_scale.1: Shed now and then by a grown, tamed dragon,
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_scale.2: and dropped by wild ones. Craft it into dragonscale armor.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_whistle.1: Calls every dragon of yours within earshot.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_whistle.2: Sneak and use it to tell them to sit and wait.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_wings.1: Wear them like an elytra and glide.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragonscale_armor.1: Wear the full set: falls can't hurt you,
tooltip.wonderrealms.elder_blade.1: Every blow lets loose one of the Elder Dragon's breaths:
tooltip.wonderrealms.elder_scale.1: Only the Elder Dragon of a Sky Citadel has these.
tooltip.wonderrealms.elder_scale.2: Eight around netherite dragon armor make Elder Dragon Armor.
tooltip.wonderrealms.ender_egg.1: Something stirs inside... perhaps it's hungry for chorus fruit?
tooltip.wonderrealms.firefly_jar.1: A jar of fireflies: a soft light that needs no fuel.
tooltip.wonderrealms.firefly_jar.2: Catch fireflies on warm nights with a glass bottle.
tooltip.wonderrealms.gem_pixel.1: Nine of them craft into a whole gem.
tooltip.wonderrealms.growth_draught.1: Brings you back to your full size.
tooltip.wonderrealms.pixel_chisel.1: Hold it to carve blocks pixel by pixel,
tooltip.wonderrealms.shrink_ray.1: Zap a mob to shrink it for 30 seconds.
tooltip.wonderrealms.shrink_ray.2: Shrunken mobs can barely hurt you.
tooltip.wonderrealms.shrinking_draught.1: Shrinks you to a tenth of your size for five minutes.
tooltip.wonderrealms.shrinking_draught.2: Tiny, you climb walls, spot dewdrops and can carve single pixels.
